hook: GPT‑6 comes to free ChatGPT — plus 4 more launches

items.claim: OpenAI says GPT‑6 is built for the 1.2 billion people who use ChatGPT weekly
Intelligent UI lets ChatGPT answer with charts, buttons and interactive tools
Claude Haiku 5.5 is now available on AWS
Clef‑omni adds full multimodality; Clef‑flash runs cheaper
Asana says its reworked browser agent ran 76× cheaper and 5× faster in tests on GPT‑6.1 Sol

caption: OpenAI brings GPT‑6 to every ChatGPT tier, including free, with an Intelligent UI that answers with charts, buttons and small tools. Also this week: Claude Haiku 5.5 on AWS, Cloudflare’s multimodal Clef‑omni, and Asana’s test results for a reworked browser agent on GPT‑6.1 Sol. Which of these will you notice first?
alt_text: Five slides on flat colour backgrounds: slide 1 says OpenAI says GPT‑6 is built for the 1.2 billion people who use ChatGPT weekly; slide 2 says Intelligent UI lets ChatGPT answer with charts, buttons and interactive tools; slide 3 says Claude Haiku 5.5 is now available on AWS; slide 4 says Clef‑omni adds full multimodality and Clef‑flash runs cheaper; slide 5 says Asana says its reworked browser agent ran 76× cheaper and 5× faster in tests on GPT‑6.1 Sol.
